sources.entry: Wastebin - Lightweight, minimal and fast pastebin with an SQLite backend. (Demo) MIT Rust/Docker

summary.one_liner: Wastebin is a minimal, self-hostable pastebin written in Rust with an axum/SQLite backend and a design copied from bin.
use_cases: share code snippets with others via a link
paste command output or logs from the terminal
host a private pastebin on a home server or VPS
render Markdown notes as HTML pastes
send temporary text that expires or self-destructs after reading
notable: Single binary with low memory footprint and SQLite storage
Syntax highlighting for more than 170 languages via syntect
Markdown pastes rendered to HTML with GitHub-flavored tables, task lists and admonitions
Client-side style paste deletion via owner token and signed cookie
Bundled wastebin-ctl tool to list, purge or delete entries
caveats: README advises against exposing it directly to the internet without rate limiting or a reverse proxy, since it lacks authentication and DoS mitigations
No user authentication or admin functionality
Documentation covers an unreleased version; released versions are listed separately
Default database path is in-memory (:memory:) unless WASTEBIN_DATABASE_PATH is set
